After that, search-api queries timed out at 5000ms (#192) and web-bff returned 504s (#194 onward). In short, a cold cache caused a stampede that overloaded the database.
The direct cause of the timeouts is catalog-db being saturated (connections, CPU). But that overload was triggered by the cache loss, not by a gradual leak or an organic rise in traffic.

verdict.recommendedAction: Cut the load on catalog-db: rate-limit or shed /search traffic and add request coalescing (single-flight) on cache misses in search-api so concurrent misses don't each hit the database. Warm redis-cache with hot product keys. Longer term: turn on RDB/AOF persistence or replica failover for redis so a node replacement doesn't bring it back empty, add jittered TTLs and stampede protection, and add a circuit breaker or connection cap from search-api to catalog-db.
